fork_reserve_update_reduced.meaning: reserve update amount is reduced directly by the modified fee mechanism in _update
fork_reserve_update_reduced.checkpoint: during swap execution before reserve update

lp_portfolio_fork.meaning: LP portfolio value measured after identical swap on the forked pair
lp_portfolio_fork.checkpoint: after swap execution on forked pair

lp_portfolio_reference.meaning: LP portfolio value measured after identical swap on the reference Uniswap-like pair
lp_portfolio_reference.checkpoint: after swap execution on reference pair

identical_swap_performed.meaning: an identical swap is performed on both the forked pair and the reference Uniswap-like pair

assumptions: The reference pair implements standard Uniswap V2 fee behavior, allowing a fair comparison of LP portfolio value.
The identical swap moves the price away from equilibrium on both pairs in the same way.

unresolved.description: No numeric definition is given for LP portfolio value; it is treated as a dimensionless observable integer for comparison.

The report does not provide an explicit constant-product invariant equation with reserve symbols and an exact post-swap equality; the selected intent is formalized as an LP portfolio comparison between fork and reference instead.

limitations: Only the direct LP portfolio decline impact i_lp_portfolio_drop is selected; value leak, fee erosion, and arbitrage extraction impacts are deferred.
The formula uses a dimensionless comparison of LP portfolio values because the report supplies no numeric reserve, swap, or portfolio amounts.

The security intent mentions charging the standard 0.3% fee from the input amount, but this is not encoded as a separate numeric predicate because the report does not define the input amount or fee value needed for it.
Actual on-chain occurrence of a swap/backrun is not asserted; the plan formalizes the stated conditional comparison scenario.
